subject: planner: add CloneForPlanCache method to Plan interface (#54295)
summary: Implements `CloneForPlanCache` for additional physical plans (IndexLookUpReader, Projection, PointGet/BatchPointGet) and adds `kv.Handle.Copy` to support deep-copying handles; updates plan-cache clone test coverage and fingerprinting; fixes child-slice cloning to avoid mutating the original plan during cloning.
